# Purrtocol Genome Nursery

> Deterministic concept-space generator for forkable Purrtocol descendants.

Interpretation:
- 199,148,544 is the theoretical genotype combination count for genome v1.
- It is NOT the number of implemented variants.
- Generated manifests are concepts only until a fork creates a real artifact.
- Same seed + genome version deterministically selects the same genes.

## Surfaces

- [Nursery Markdown](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-nursery/index.md): Algorithm, lifecycle, and evidence boundary.
- [Interactive Nursery](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-nursery/): Browser concept breeder.
- [Genome JSON](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-genome.json): Canonical gene options.
- [Python breeder](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/scripts/breed_purrtocol.py): Reproducible CLI implementation.
- [Variant schema](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-variant.schema.json): Genome-aware lineage manifest contract.
- [Variant Foundry](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-variant-foundry/index.md): Implementation/fork/indexing path.
